name: Mira Krein
source:
Mira is [url=https://vndb.org/c144569]Lilith[/url]'s mother [spoiler]and one of my women. Even after I raped her, she didn't hate me. On the contrary, she realized that only I am capable of giving her true pleasure and genuine love. She left her husband for [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url] and Lilith because she understood that only I can give her what she has been searching for all this time.[/spoiler]
